pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sattarasavaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sañcicca kukkuccaṃ upadahanti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:1.10: ime āvuso chabbaggiyā bhikkhū amhākaṃ sañcicca kukkuccaṃ upadahantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:1.12: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhūnaṃ sañcicca kukkuccaṃ upadahissantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:1.17: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:1.18: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:1.19.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa sañcicca kukkuccaṃ upadaheyya iti 'ssa muhuttaṃ pi aphāsu bhavissatīti etad eva paccayaṃ karitvā anaññaṃ, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:2.1.10: ūnavīsativasso maññe tvaṃ upasampanno, vikāle maññe tayā bhuttaṃ, majjaṃ maññe tayā pītaṃ, mātugāmena saddhiṃ raho maññe tayā nisinnan ti kukkuccaṃ upadahati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:2.1.11: etad eva paccayaṃ karitvā anaññan ti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:2.1.12: na añño koci paccayo hoti kukkuccaṃ upadahituṃ. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:2.2.1: upasampanne upasampannasaññī sañcicca kukkuccaṃ upadahati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:2.2.4: anupasampannassa sañcicca kukkuccaṃ upadahati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:2.3.2: na kukkuccaṃ upadahitukāmo ūnavīsativasso maññe tvaṃ upasampanno, vikāle . . . nisinnaṃ, iṅgha jānāhi mā te pacchā kukkuccaṃ ahosīti bhaṇati;
